feeds.title: Gundam News
feeds.description: We are a news/media web publication delivering professional quality coverage of the Mobile Suit Gundam franchise.

feeds.title: Gunpla 101 Blog
feeds.description: We are a husband and wife team of Gundam fanatics. We are not Gunpla masters. But we don't think you need to be one to get the most possible enjoyment out of the Gunpla building. There's no one 'correct' way to build Gunpla. Let our tips, tricks, and techniques guide you, but don't make them your bible. We want to encourage you to build Gunpla in a way that makes you feel good.

feeds.title: Saint-ism Blog
feeds.description: YJ is an IT Consultant living in Melbourne, Australia, and a gaming enthusiast. I started gaming at age 6 and grew up enjoying just about every genre of gaming from adventure, FPS, RTS, RPG, racing, to turn-based strategy. In 2002 I was introduced to the world of Gundam, which drew me in immediately with its deep storyline and mecha designs. Eventually, I started collecting Gundam plastic models (or 'Gunpla'), and ever since then I've been building and painting them, trying to improve my skills to achieve the best finish possible.

feeds.title: Gunpla by GoodGuyDan
feeds.description: Gunpla by GoodGuyDan is a blog about Gundam and Gunpla, featuring complete kits from 2018/2019.2020/2021, along with tutorials, tools, reviews, and more.

feeds.title: Kimi The Builder Blog
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to documenting my journey from a mediocre builder to a better builder. While sharing my thoughts and opinions on the kits that I have built. As well talk about all the awesome upcoming Gunplas that are coming our way.

feeds.title: CustoMecha
feeds.description: CustoMecha is a blog that was created to showcase remodeling, painting, and customizing the build of different Gunpla and other Mecha models. This serves as a channel for hobbyists, modelers, and enthusiasts for continuing their passion for collecting and/or modifying.

feeds.title: Kusakusa Gunpla
feeds.description: I'm just your average adult who's still playing with plastic robots. Currently in Gunpla-land a.k.a Japan. Why am I still playing with plastic robots? Part of the fun is in the building and the ability to customize your models with different color schemes and various decals. My favorite scale to work play with is the 1/144 scale (HG, RG) because they're small, cheap, and more fun to modify and customize.

feeds.title: Gunplanerd
feeds.description: Insights, reviews, and discussions about Gunpla and other model kits from the perspective of a casual Builder. Mainstream or alternative, everything is fair game!

feeds.title: Gundam Kits Collection
feeds.description: Gundam Kits Collection helps people to provide knowledge about Gundam kits, updates newly built Gundam, and reviews.

feeds.title: HLJ.com Blog
feeds.description: The following section of HobbyLink is dedicated to articles, news, and updates on Gundam. Starting in 1995, HobbyLink Japan is an online retailer located in the foothills of Tochigi Prefecture, Japan. We ship hobby products, toys, anime items, books, and more to customers all over the world.
